description: Tests a sink by sending it a sample alert. Give a saved sink ID to test its stored configuration, or a complete webhook draft to test unsaved edits. A draft must include the URL and every header value, because stored secrets are never returned or reused. Checks never save configuration changes.

responseBody.description: The beginning of the response body of the destination, to help troubleshooting. It is truncated.
responseBody.title: responseBody

sinkID.description: The saved sink to test with its stored configuration.
sinkID.title: sinkID

status.description: Succeeded when the destination answered with a 2xx status. Failed when it could not be reached or refused the request.
status.title: status

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the response, when the destination answered.
statusCode.title: statusCode

type.description: The type of the sink to test.
type.title: type

webhook.description: The complete, unsaved webhook configuration to test. Give it or sinkID. The draft is never saved.
webhook.title: webhook

title: SinkCheck
